answer: Splitting into sybils multiplies staking capital and monitoring effort, so a farmer spreading thin across a tundra of fake identities starves each one, while an honest grove of agents amortizes the cost and stays profitable. Require each agent to stake a bond and pass a liveness challenge only a persistent operator can sustain: a slow pulse of signed heartbeats over many epochs, each tied to a unique funding path. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
